title: I created Aurora, an autonomous AI research agent that turns your ideas into strategies you can inspect, test, and deploy. AMA
author: NextgenAITrading
selftext:
My name is Austin Starks, and I created the viral [**Public Portfolio Challenge**](https://nexustrade.io/blog/series/public-portfolio-challenge), an experiment where I give money to an AI and let it trade. To date, I have two different experiments😄 

* The original Public Portfolio Challenge, where I gave the AI my watchlist and told it to create an options trading strategy. [**See the full runbook on GitHub**](https://github.com/austin-starks/public-portfolio-challenge)
* The brand new Biotech + Semis version, which is outperforming the S&P 500 by 380%. [**See how I made that one with Grok Bot and Claude Code**](https://nexustrade.io/blog/moderna-basically-cured-cancer-i-used-grok-bot-to-create-a-trading-strategy-20260823)

I'm here to answer questions about why I made this challenge, my thoughts on agentic trading, and how you can create your own AI trading bots. While my app is technically a "commercial" platform because I charge a subscription, I have a very generous free tier and am giving all [**Redditors free access for the month of October.**](https://nexustrade.io/october/) 

**Please note, you don't have to send me $1 to deploy your own bots**; you can connect with Claude Code, point the GitHub repo, and tell it to copy my idea or help you make your own using the same quantitative process. I'll even help you setup the [**Massive API**](https://massive.com) or [**Public MCP**](https://public.com/api/docs/templates/hosted-mcp)**.** My goal isn't to sell you something you don't need; it's to help you understand agentic trading and help you (safely) set up your first trading bot.

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: two biotech catalysts since early October would be a very different claim from a research agent finding edge, so on the biotech plus semis number: 380% over the S&P from what start date, and how many names carry it?

replies.author: NextgenAITrading
replies.body: [You can see the portfolio here!](https://nexustrade.io/shared-portfolio/6a8cb4ebc57fd738a24f1a41?view=app) It started August 25th, 2026. Yes, it's not a long time, but we all have to start somewhere, right?

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: two months is a start, and a public portfolio is the right way to show it. the one thing I'd add is the start date printed beside the benchmark on the same page, so the biotech and semis number reads against the S&P from Aug 25 and not from the best entry in the window.

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: no problem. I'll look again once the start date sits next to the benchmark on the page.
